status: Reviewed source-only fixed plan; no compilation or filter execution authorized
stopping: Exactly ledger; no outcome-dependent sample extension or threshold changes
optional_summary: Within-block geometric A0/A1 reference; shared samples remain dependent, no independent-observation inflation
typed_path: A0/A1 share the exact same noinline typed measurement specialization and code address; all three type specializations have the same noinline rule; native inline attributes unchanged
balance_scope: Every four-row block: each arm once per position, each distinct directed predecessor once inside rows. Across-row/process carryover not claimed balanced.
ratio_direction: Every named ratio is numerator latency / denominator latency; >1 means numerator slower. These are not old control/candidate speedup ratios.

analysis_definition.per_arm: All32 absolute-ns trials; median/min/max and ns per new hash retained separately.
analysis_definition.pair_estimator: For each fixed cell/contract/seed, take mean of four per-repeat log latency ratios within each complete Williams cycle, then exponentiate the mean across eight cycle means.
analysis_definition.bootstrap: Draw eight complete cycles with replacement10000 times; identical index draws used for every contrast in the same cell/contract/seed, retaining shared-sample dependence. Percentile endpoints at0.025/0.975 use linear interpolation of sorted replicates with rank(B-1)*p.
analysis_definition.all_comparisons: Retain all six individual contrasts and every cycle/trial. Aref is secondary only. Never pool cells, contracts, languages or input seeds.
analysis_definition.classification: Negative controls inside means every full pointwise95% block interval for A1/A0,Clone/A0,Clone/A1 falls within[0.97,1.03] at both seeds. Only then label policy consistently slower/faster when both Policy/A0 and Policy/A1 intervals fall wholly above1.03/below0.97 at both seeds. Wholly inside for all policy intervals is practically within band, not no effect. Everything else unresolved; no optional extension.
analysis_definition.limitations: Eight blocks and bootstrap independence/representativeness assumptions do not prove absence of impact or generalize beyond measured cases; no familywise causal guarantee.
